You arrive in a bedroom. A typical one.

You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a chest drawer. You see a closed antique trunk. You scan the room, seeing a king-size bed. The king-size bed is standard. But the thing is empty. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it!

There is a closed wooden door leading east.

thought: I should open the antique trunk in the chest drawer to see if it contains any bag of chips or something useful for grilling.
feedback: You open the antique trunk.
